question.prompt: Postman Pete has a pedometer to count his steps. The pedometer records up to \(99999\) steps, then flips over to \(00000\) on the next step. Pete plans to determine his mileage for a year. On January \(1\) Pete sets the pedometer to \(00000.\) During the year, the pedometer flips from \(99999\) to \(00000\) forty-four times. On December \(31\) the pedometer reads \(50000.\) Pete takes \(1800\) steps per mile. Which of the following is closest to the number of miles Pete walked during the year?

solutions.explanation:
Each rollover represents \(100000\) steps: after reaching \(99999\), one more step returns the display to \(00000\). Thus the forty-four rollovers account for forty-four complete blocks of \(100000\) steps, and the final reading adds another \(50000\) steps. Pete's total is
\[
44\cdot100000+50000=4450000\text{ steps}.
\]
Since each mile takes \(1800\) steps, he walked
\[
\frac{4450000}{1800}=\frac{22250}{9}\approx2472.2\text{ miles}.
\]
This is below \(2500\), the smallest answer choice, so every larger choice is farther away. The closest distance is \(\boxed{2500}\) miles, choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
solutions.title: Count complete cycles and convert to miles
